outcome: Incidence of obstetric massive blood transfusion (MBT)
cohort: 11,667,406 hospitalized pregnant women in China from 2012 to 2019
finding: The incidence of obstetric massive blood transfusion (MBT) increased in China from 2012 to 2019, with amniotic fluid embolism, uterine atony, abnormal placenta, severe anemia, ectopic pregnancy, abortion, Cesarean section, advanced maternal age, and multiparity identified as risk factors.
mod_finding: Cesarean section was identified as a risk factor for obstetric massive blood transfusion.
